book.name: Luke
book.title: Luke Angketj Jesu Christ-akert Luke-elarl pip-warn arrernekarl, peltj kwerenh arreny Theophilus-warn lanthetjeh-anngernt

content: Inang Jesu renh Pilate-eng ularr pawenhek
Council kemerremel inang Jesu renh twernk Rome-areny-warn arreny kwerenh Pilate-warn tjey-angek.

Inang renh Pilate-eng ularr rrtjwerremel ilek, “Nwernarrp artwang nhenh arek awek thwen, rang tjerrtj map ilek, inang itja Rome-areny government-eh kangkwerretjeh. Inang twernk angerr Caesar-eh tax maney anthetj-kwenh anetjeh. Rang ilelhek, rang Christ king-arl kwel nwerneh anemeng.”
Pilate-el Jesu renh pawenhek, “Arratjam ntwang tjerrtj Jew map-henh king anem?” Jesu-el renh tjernemel ilek, “Ntwang kwenh arratj angkek.”
Pilate-elemeh priest twernk map tjerrtj aningk ingkern petjekarl map thwen ilek, “Artwang nhenh itja merrentj anem. Thang renh mentj impem, alpetjeh.”

Inang ahang-irremel ilek, “Jesu rartek tjerrtj map ilek, inang itja government-eh kangkwerretjeh! Rang tjerrtj rwekenth-kenth-ilenh-ilenh! Rang mer Judea ntjaperel tjerrtj map lakenh pal kaltj-antherl-apetjart. Jesu rang nheng mer Galilee-el-amparr rwekenth-kenth-ilerl-apetjam, kwereng rang kwewaleny rrwernelhekarl mer nhenhelemeh.”
Pilate-el Jesu renh king Herod-warn lanthek
Pilate-el nhenh awemel rang inenh pawenhek, “Artwang nhenh mer Galilee-areny key?”

Inang renh ilek, “Rang kwenh artwang Galilee-areny anem.” Herod rang twernk anek mer Galilee-ek. Pilate-el renh king Herod-warn lanthek. Herod rang arltang kwerel Jerusalem kwerel anek, yatjarr petjekarl.
King Herod-el Jesu pawenhek

Herod-el arrwekel angketj Jesu-akert awentjekarl. Rang ahentj-anek, Jesu renh aretjeh ngkweyeng-ntjel. Rang ahentj-anek, Jesu-el kwereng ularr alker-areny twer angerrel mpwaretjeh kwel. Lakenheng rang kangkek, Pilate-el Jesu renh kwer-warn lanthekarleng.
Kel inang Jesu renh Herod kwer-warn angek. Herod-el Jesu renh map-ingar pawenhek. Jesu rang intert kwet angketj-kweny anek.
Priest twernk map artwang Moses-henh mpwareng-areng kaltj-anthenh-anthenh map thwen inang irnetjam. Inang Jesu renh ahang-irremel ilterrerretjam.
Kwereng Herod-el atwenh-atwenh kwerenh mapel thwen Jesu renh arrkentj-iletjam-arlk. King-henh mantarr amparrkey-arrkey-warn inang renh kwernek. Kwereng Herod-el renh Pilate-warn angkep lanthek.
Arltang kwerel Herod Pilate ratherr peltjemeh irrek. Arrwekel ratherr arnkely-arnkely anerrek.
Pilate-el atwenh-atwenh map lanthek,Jesu renh irrernng atwetjeh
Kwereng Pilate-el priest twernk map arraw-ilek, angerrepat twernk map tjerrtj arrpenh map-arlk thwen.

Rang inenh ilek, “Arrantherr artwang nhenh tjeng-warn angetjek. Arrantherr yengenh ilek, rang kwel tjerrtj map ilerleh, inang government-ek itja kangkwerretjeh. Thang renh mantjel pawenhek arrehantherreng anngetherr. Yeng iterrem, rang itja merrentj anem.
Herod-el ilek, rang itja merrentj anem, renh nwerneh-warn angkep lanthemel. Thang itja renh pelkel irrernng atwetjeh.
Lakenheng thang atwenh-atwenh map iletjenh, renh whip-el atwetjeh. Kwer-penh thang renh mentjemeh impetjenh.”
Inang ingkerrek arlkemel ilek, “Renh atwerrerrang! Barabbas renh-amparr nwerneh tjayeleng arratelh-ilerrerrang!”

(Barabbas rang nheng tjerrtj map ilekarleng, inang itja Rome-areny government-eh kangkwerretjeh. Inang atwenh-atwenh mapel-ayeng atwerretjart. Rang tjerrtj arrpenh map irrernng atwek. Lwerenh-penh inang renh tjayel-warn merrentjemeh kwernek.)
Pilate ahentj-anek, Jesu renh mentjemeh impetjeh. Lakenheng rang tjerrtj inenh weth ilek, “Nhenh kwenh artwang pelkeny!”
Inang arlkemel angkek, “Renh kel ntwerlkeh arrernewarrang! Renh kel ntwerlkeh arrernewarrang!”

Pilate-el inenh pawenhek, “Wenham rang anetj mpwarek? Thang renh itja irrernng atwem, rang artwang pelkeny anemeng. Lakenheng thang atwenh-atwenh map iletjenh, renh whip-el atwetjeh war. Kwereng thang renh kel mentjemeh impetjenh, artwang pelkeny wart.”
Inang kwet arnterram-arnterr arlkek, rang Jesu renh ntwerlkeh arrernetjeh kwet. Pilate-el inenh ywarn kwet intertelh-ilek.
Lakenheng rang ineh kel kangkwerrek.

Pilate rang artwang merrentj nheng tjayeleng arratelh-ilek, artwang rarl tjerrtj map ilekarl, itja government-eh kangkwerretjeh. Rang Jesu renh atwenh-atwenh map-warn lanthek, inang renh ntwerlkeh arrernetjeh, tjerrtj map ahentj-anekarl-arteh.
Atwenh-atwenh mapel Jesu renhntwerlkeh arrernewarrek

Atwenh-atwenh mapel Jesu renh Jerusalem-eng keth-warn tjey-angek, ntwerlkeh arrernetjeh-anngernt. Inang artwang nyent arek ularr petjerleh, arreny kwerenh Simon. Rang artwang mer Cyrene-areny anek. Atwenh-atwenh mapel Simon renh rrkwek. Inang ntwerlk kwer-arleh tjwenek, renh twernemel, ntwerlk renh Jesu-eng anharrel-ayeng angerl-apetjeh.
Tjerrtj aningk Jesu-eng ingkern-angkwerr petjewarretjam. Marl rrpwetj-arlk inehel-ayeng petjek. Inang Jesu-eh angerr akay arnek.
Jesu-el inenh alngarelhemel arek. Rang inenh ilek, “Marl Jerusalem-areny mapay, tjeng arnetjal anerrerrang! Arrantherr arrehantherrarrp arnelh-arnelh-ilerrang, amenheng-nheng arrehantherr-henheh.

Kelant inang arrantherrenh Jerusalem-areny map rwekenth-kenth-iletjenh. Arrantherr angketjenh, ‘Marl kwer-kwenh map kwenh arrken anem! Marl kwer-akert map ltarrp-irrem-anem, atwenh-atwenh mapel kwer inehenh atwetjenharl.’ Arltang kwerel arrantherr Altjerr renh pawenhetjenh,

content.text: pwert nhenh map ntwang arrewetjeh mpwarang,

content: “Lyet inang yeng, tjerrtj pelkeny rwekenth-kenth-ilemel atwem. Ngwenth war inang arrantherrenh tjerrtj ahelh-areny map angerr-lkwer rwekenth-kenth-ilemel atwetjenh!”
Artwang merrentj atherr arrpenh thwen inang Jesu-el-ayel tjey-angek, renh-atherrenh ntwerlkeh arrernetjeh-anngernt.

Inang mer kwer irretj-alhek, renharl inang ilem, “Kapert ngkwern”. Inang Jesu renh ntwerlkeh nail-el tanthemel arrernek. Kwereng artwang anetj nheng atherr inang ntwerlkeh arrernek, Jesu-eng iter atherrel, Jesu kenh mpwepelarl.
Jesu angkek, “Angeyay, anetj inehenh wang. Inang kwenh itja kaltj, inarl Ler ngkwengenh irrernng atwemeng.” Atwenh-atwenh inang Jesu-henh mantarr map irrarnpelh-ilek gamble-irremel.

Tjerrtj petjekarl mapel renh aretjamarl. Twernk mapel renh arrampewetjam. Inang lakenh angkerrek, “Rang arrpenh map iteth-ilek irrernngeng. Lwerenheng kwel rang apek Christ anemeng, renharl Altjerrel ngkernekarl, rang ntwerlkeng anarnpemel kwewaleny iteth-ilelhemer!”
Atwenh-atwenh map itwek-irrek, renh arrampewetjeh. Inang kwer wine tjekert anthek.
Inang renh arrkentj-ilemel iletjam, “Ntwang arratj key tjerrtj Jew map-henh king anem? Kel ntwerlkeng ngkwewaleny anarnp-ilelhang!”

Tjerrtj arrpenh mapel arrwekel angketj nhenh arnang kwek-warn tanthekarl, “Nhenh rang kwenh tjerrtj Jew map-henh king.” Kwereng atwenh-atwenh nyentel arnang nhenh ntwerlkeh ampek-arrernek, Jesu-henh kaperteng kernenyel.
Artwang merrentj nyent, rarl ntwerlkel arlpar-irnetjam, rang Jesu renh arrampewemel ilek, “Ntwang key Christ rang? Ngkwewaleny anarnp-ilelhang, ilernenh-arlk!”
Artwang merrentj arrpenhel renh arnpakemel ilek, “Renh impay, arrkentj-iletj-kweny anetjeh! Ntwang ater-irretjeh Altjerreng! Inang nwernenh rrpwetj merrentj ilek, ntwerlkel ilwetjeh rrpwetj-antey.
Nhenh kel arratj anem, ilern ilwetjeh lakenh, ilern anetj mernelhekarleng. Kenh artwang nhenh pelkenyarl anem.”
Rang Jesu-warn angkek, “Jesu-ay, tjeng irlpangkay, ntwang tjerrtj ingkerrekeh Ngkart anemeng mer ngkwengenhel.”
Jesu-el renh tjernemel ilek, “Thang ngwenh alhelem, lyet ntwang tjengel-ayel anetjenh mer mwerrel.”
Jesu ilwek
Kel aherrk irntarel anek. Aherrk rang ngwemernt-irrek, mer ntjaper ngwemernt anek angwerreh-atwetj.
Mantarr angerretj nheng, rarl Altjerr-henh church angerr kwenel arlpar-anetjamarl, rang mpwep anthwerr kerneng kwenelakw alterrelherl-alhek.
Jesu-el arnterr arlkemel ilek, “Angeyay, thang ngkweng-warn kwerrern tjengenh lanthem, ntwang arntarnt-aretjeh.” Rang lakenh angkemel kel ilwekemeh.
Atwenh-atwenh map-henh twernkel nhenh aremel, rang Altjerr nakek, lakenh angkemel, “Artwang nhenh arratjam anek, anetj-kwenh!”
Tjerrtj arrpenh map, inarl war aretjeh petjekarl, inang nhenh arekarleng, inang ltarrp-irrek. Inang arnangk atwelhemel alpekemeh.
Jesu-henh peltj map, marl nheng map thwen, inarl mer Galilee-eng-ntjel kwereng anharrel-ayeng petjekarl, inang nhenh ingkerrek ntwarreng aretjam.
Inang Jesu-henh mpwerrk intey-warn arrernewarrek

Artwang angerrepat nyent anek, arreny kwerenh Joseph. Rang town Arimathea-areny anek, mer Judea-el. Joseph nhenh artwang irlpareth anek. Rang karelhetjam, Altjerr mernelhetjeh, rang tjerrtj ingkerrekeh Ngkart anemeng. Rang Council-areny anek. Rang itja ahentj-anek, Council inang Jesu renh court-ilemel merrentj iletjeh.
Jesu-arl ilwekarl-penh, Joseph rang twernk Pilate-warn alhek, Jesu-henh mpwerrkeh pawenhetjeh.

Kwereng rang Jesu-henh mpwerrk ntwerlkeng anarnpelh-ilek. Rang mpwerrk mantarrel arltwemel artaper-ilek, kwereng intey-warn renh angemel arrernerl-alpek. Tjerrtj irrernng itja arrwekel intey nhenh kwerel arrernekarl apek.
Nhenh kel Friday angwerr-angwerr, ngkwa arltang angerr Saturday anek, ltjwerrenh-rrenh. Inang arltang kwereng arrwekel kwet mpwarek.
Marl nheng map inarl Jesu-eng anharrel-ayeng petjekarl mer Galilee-eng-ntjel, inang Joseph-eng ingkern-angkwerr alhek. Inang arek, rang Jesu-henh mpwerrk inemel, awelng-warn arrernekarl-penh.

Kwereng inang mer-warn alpek. Inang anter npwang mwerr-akert inek, Jesu-henh mpwerrk kelant pernetjeh-anngerntel. Inang itja arltang Saturday-el alhek, Jesu-henh mpwerrk pernetjeh, Altjerr-henh angketjel arnpakekarleng, itja arltang angerr Saturday-el rrkwapetjeh.

footnotes.text: Mer-areny mapel tjenkerr-rlwer anyenemeng, Pilate-el artwang nyent arratelh-ilek tjayeleng. Lakenh rang mpwaretjart.
Tjerrtj Jew mapel lakenh iterretjart Friday angwerr-angwerrel. “Nwern rrkwapentj impetjeh-anem. Nwern itja kwet arltang angerr Saturday-el rrkwapetjeh, arltang ltjwerrenh-rrenh.”
